arxiv-1912-07182.title: Effect of Pixelation on the Parameter Estimation of Single Molecule Trajectories
arxiv-1912-07182.creator: Milad R. Vahid, Bernard Hanzon, and Raimund J. Ober
arxiv-1912-07182.description: Abstract The advent of single molecule microscopy has revolutionized biological investigations by providing a powerful tool for the study of intercellular and intracellular trafficking processes of protein molecules which was not available before through conventional microscopy. In practice, pixelated detectors are used to acquire the images of fluorescently labeled objects moving in cellular environments.

arxiv-2105-13115.title: On Hodge Structures and Periods - Part I: Algebraic Aspects
arxiv-2105-13115.creator: Lucian M. Ionescu
arxiv-2105-13115.description: Abstract . We review Hodge structures, relating filtrations, Galois Theory and Jordan-Holder structures. The prototypical case of periods of Riemann surfaces is compared with the Galois-Artin framework of algebraic numbers. 1. Introduction Periods [ 3 ] are also “numbers” computed as Feynman integrals accurately representing scattering amplitudes measured in particle accelerator experiments [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2203-00723.title: The Energetics of the Central Engine in the Powerful Quasar, 3C298 Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2203-00723.creator: Brian Punsly, Christian Groeneveld, Gary J. Hill, Paola Marziani, Gregory R. Zeimann, Donald P. Schneider
arxiv-2203-00723.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Brian Punsly, Christian Groeneveld, Gary J. Hill, Paola Marziani, Gregory R. Zeimann, Donald P. Schneider. The compact steep spectrum radio source, 3C 298, (redshift of 1.44) has the largest 178 MHz luminosity in the 3CR (revised Third Cambridge Catalogue) catalog; its radio lobes are among the most luminous in the Universe. The plasma state of the radio lobes is modeled with the aid of interferometric radio observations (in particular, the new Low Frequency Array observation and archival MERLIN data) and archival single-station data.

arxiv-2405-11219.title: Identifying and Aligning Medical Claims Made on Social Media with Medical Evidence
arxiv-2405-11219.description: Abstract Evidence-based medicine is the practise of making medical decisions that adhere to the latest, and best known evidence at that time. Currently, the best evidence is often found in the form of documents, such as randomized control trials, meta-analyses and systematic reviews. This research focuses on aligning medical claims made on social media platforms with this medical evidence.

arxiv-2407-04004.creator: G. Angloher addrMPI, S. Banik addrHEPHY,addrAI, G. Benato addrLNGS,addrGSSI, A. Bento addrMPI,addrCoimbra, A. Bertolini addrMPI, R. Breier addrBratislava, C. arxiv-2408-00872.title: Online Detection of Anomalies in Temporal Knowledge Graphs with Interpretability
arxiv-2408-00872.creator: Jiasheng Zhang, Rex Ying, Jie Shao
arxiv-2408-00872.description: Abstract . Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) are valuable resources for capturing evolving relationships among entities, yet they are often plagued by noise, necessitating robust anomaly detection mechanisms. Existing dynamic graph anomaly detection approaches struggle to capture the rich semantics introduced by node and edge categories within TKGs, while TKG embedding methods lack interpretability, undermining the credibility of anomaly detection.

arxiv-2412-11211.title: Deep Learning-based Approaches for State Space Models: A Selective Review
arxiv-2412-11211.creator: Jiahe Lin, George Michailidis
arxiv-2412-11211.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiahe Lin, George Michailidis. State-space models (SSMs) offer a powerful framework for dynamical system analysis, wherein the temporal dynamics of the system are assumed to be captured through the evolution of the latent states, which govern the values of the observations. This paper provides a selective review of recent advancements in deep neural network-based approaches for SSMs, and presents a unified perspective for discrete time deep state space models and continuous time ones such as latent neural Ordinary Differential and Stochastic Differential Equations.

arxiv-2501-07543.title: A Comprehensive Search for Leptoquarks Decaying into Top- τ \tau Final States at the Future LHC
arxiv-2501-07543.creator: Debabrata Sahoo, Rameswar Sahu, Kirtiman Ghosh
arxiv-2501-07543.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Debabrata Sahoo, Rameswar Sahu, Kirtiman Ghosh. We studied the collider phenomenology of third-generation scalar leptoquarks at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) with a 14 TeV center-of-mass energy. The analysis focuses on leptoquarks decaying exclusively into top quarks and tau leptons, employing machine learning-based tagging techniques for identifying hadronically decaying boosted top quarks, W/Z, and Higgs bosons, as well as a multivariate classifier to distinguish signal events from Standard Model (SM) backgrounds.

arxiv-2503-17311.title: Early solar wind and dynamo magnetic field topology predictions for (16) Psyche and other asteroids
arxiv-2503-17311.description: Abstract Asteroid (16) Psyche is a metal-rich body that might record an ancient coherent magnetization if some relict crust or mantle is preserved. Herein, we use magnetohydrodynamic simulations to predict (16) Psyche’s field, assuming it has such relicts that were magnetized after nebula dispersal via one of two distinct pathways: i.

arxiv-2507-12693.title: Placebo Discontinuity Design
arxiv-2507-12693.creator: Rahul Singh, Moses Stewart
arxiv-2507-12693.description: Abstract Standard regression discontinuity design (RDD) models rely on the continuity of expected potential outcomes at the cutoff. The standard continuity assumption can be violated by strategic manipulation of the running variable, which is realistic when the cutoff is widely known and when the treatment of interest is a social program or government benefit.

The porous structure crystallised from a flexible building block prepared using 1,4-diaminobutane as linker. The close packed structures were prepared using either piperazine or 1,4-bis(aminomethyl)benzene as a linker and have less conformational freedom. 1.

The native range of P.

pmc-10668087.title: Arteriovenous cerebral blood flow correlation in moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury: CT perfusion study
pmc-10668087.creator: Alex O Trofimov, Darya I Agarkova, Kseniia A Trofimova, Edwin M Nemoto, Olga A Bragina, Denis E Bragin
pmc-10668087.description: IntroductionThe relationship between arterial and venous blood flow in moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) is poorly understood.The research questionwas to compare differences in perfusion computed tomography (PCT)-derived arterial and venous cerebral blood flow (CBF) in moderate-to-severe TBI as an indication of changes in cerebral venous outflow patterns referenced to arterial inflow.

pmc-11585767.title: DUF99 family proteins are novel endonucleases that cleave deoxyuridine on DNA substrates
pmc-11585767.creator: Jinquan Li, Runyue Xia, Wen-Cong Huang, Jiazheng Gu, Meng Li
pmc-11585767.description: DNA deamination occurs constantly in a cell and causes DNA damage. As this damage can be deleterious, organisms have evolved many systems to eliminate it, such as Endonuclease V (Endo V). DUF99 family protein contains a domain of unknown function similar to Endo V but has not been experimentally characterized to date.

pmc-11610386.title: Advancing Polyphenol-Based Nanomedicine for Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Challenges and Opportunities
pmc-11610386.creator: Liucan Wang, Guoqing Chen, Yang Yang, Chao Xu, Li Zhu, Hua Yang, Min Yu
pmc-11610386.description: Oxidative stress, characterized by excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), is a critical factor in the progression of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and presents a potential therapeutic target. Anti-oxidant therapy, aimed at mitigating excessive ROS, is emerging as a cornerstone in IBD treatment.

pmc-12472044.title: Phytochemical Analysis and Appraisal of Antiproliferative Activity of Magnolia alejandrae
pmc-12472044.creator: José E. Caballero-Chávez, Alma D. Paz-González, Diana V. Navarrete-Carriola, Fabián E. Olazarán-Santibañez, María Miriam Estevez-Carmona, Benjamín Nogueda-Torres, Fernando Emiliano Jiménez-Mondragón, Melany X. Márquez-Aguilar, Carmen Michelle Pineda-Alcala, Diego Cisneros-Juárez, Álvaro Marín-Hernán
pmc-12472044.description: Background: Magnolia alejandrae is a tree endemic to Tamaulipas, Mexico, distributed in the forests of the Sierra Madre Oriental. Objective: Our objective was to analyze the secondary metabolite profile of different parts of M. alejandrae and evaluate their antiproliferative activity in vitro.

pmc-12473656.title: Room Temperature Synthesis of a Novel Quinolinoxazine, Polymerization and Flammability Studies
pmc-12473656.creator: Maria Laura Salum, Daniela Iguchi, Carlos Rodriguez Arza, Nora Pellegri, Hatsuo Ishida, Pablo Froimowicz, Nicolas Sbirrazzuoli
pmc-12473656.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). A novel quinoline-containing benzoxazine resin, 8HQ-fa, has been successfully synthesized at room temperature using sustainable raw materials, such as 8-hydroxyquinoline and furfurylamine as the phenol and amine source, respectively. The chemical structure of the hereinafter referred to as quinolinoxazine is fully characterized by Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (NMR), as well as by 2D 1H–1H nuclear Overhauser effect spectroscopy (NOESY) and 1H–13C heteronuclear multiple quantum correlation (HMQC) NMR.

pmc-12541320.title: The autophagy-specific exocyst subcomplex contributes to phagophore assembly site integrity by promoting phagophore expansion
pmc-12541320.creator: Ruchika Kumari, Titikhya Nath, Jeremy Pflaum, Inchara R, Sannannagari Vinay, Florian Wilfling, Ravi Manjithaya
pmc-12541320.description: SignificanceThis study significantly enhances our understanding of membrane expansion during autophagy by decoding the role of the tethering complex exocyst during autophagosome biogenesis. Using yeast genetics, we show that the autophagy-specific exocyst subcomplex is essential for preserving the integrity of the phagophore assembly site (PAS) during autophagosome biogenesis.

pmc-12615694.title: Investigating the potential advantages of using thorium-based fuel as an advanced nuclear fuel in a typical boiling water reactor assembly (BWR)
pmc-12615694.creator: Nassar Alnassar, A. Abdelghafar Galahom
pmc-12615694.description: The long-term sustainability of Boiling water reactor (BWR) fuel cycles is challenged by the accumulation of reactor-grade plutonium (rgPu), minor actinides (MAs), and high-level radiotoxic waste in spent fuel. This study investigates the potential of thorium-based fuels as an alternative to conventional uranium dioxide (UO2) to address these issues and improve fuel cycle performance.

pmc-12703001.title: Selective depletion of tumor-associated SAMHD1 enhances chemotherapeutic efficacy and antitumor immune responses
pmc-12703001.creator: Jing Sun, Wenwen Zheng, Zheng-Guo Zhang, Hongkun Zhou, Songdi Wang, Dingbo Huang, Xiao-Yi Hu, Qing-Feng Yu, Zhao-Xing Wu, Yi-Fei Shi, Runxin Ye, Fengyan Xia, Wangwei Li, Shurui Lyu, Yu Huang, Xu-Zhao Zhang, Fei Xu, Ke Zhao, Jie Yang, Juan Du, Jiaming Su, Yajuan Rui, Rongzhen Xu, Wei-Ming Yang, Cang
pmc-12703001.description: SAMHD1 is a human deoxyribonucleoside triphosphatase (dNTPase) known for its role as a restriction factor that targets a wide spectrum of viruses, its involvement in autoimmune disease Aicardi–Goutières syndrome (AGS), and its participation in innate immune regulation. The role of SAMHD1 in cancer, particularly its contribution to drug resistance, has gained increasing attention in recent years.

pmc-12710074.title: InVEST Model and Landscape Indices Reveal Habitat Quality Degradation From Land Use Changes in South China
pmc-12710074.creator: Xiaojun Wang, Guangxu Liu, Hong Jia
pmc-12710074.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The intensification of human activities has degraded the ecological environment of Hunan Province in South China. Existing studies on the province's habitat quality (HQ) primarily focus on specific landscapes or geomorphic zones, lacking quantitative analysis of the contribution of land use and land cover change (LULC) to HQ changes, as well as the application of landscape indices to characterize HQ dynamics. This study evaluated HQ changes in Hunan Province from 2000 to 2023, landscape indices, and spatial autocorrelation analysis.

pmc-13177885.title: Behavioral responses of healthcare providers to prospective payment systems: a systematic review using the WHO framework (2000–2024)
pmc-13177885.creator: Anahita Behzadi, Zohreh Bagherinezhad, Maliheh Ghobadi
pmc-13177885.description: BackgroundProspective payment systems (PPS) have become increasingly prevalent in healthcare globally, yet their impact on provider behavior remains complex and context-dependent. This systematic review examines the behavioral responses of healthcare providers to PPS using the World Health Organization’s four-function framework.MethodsA comprehensive systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines.

pmc-13292474.title: Development and frontier trends of research on the gut microbiota and cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13292474.creator: Xusheng Zhang, Hongkun Yin, Di Liu, Tao Jiao, Qi Wang
pmc-13292474.description: BackgroundAlthough research on the gut microbiota and cholangiocarcinoma has developed rapidly in recent years, and the gut microbiota plays an important role in cholangiocarcinoma, there is currently a lack of comprehensive and objective understanding of the latest progress and future research directions in this field. This study comprehensively evaluated and visually analyzed this research area based on bibliometric methods.

pmc-13435053.title: General method for generating functionalized arylsilyllithium species
pmc-13435053.creator: Natsumi Hammyo, Rikuro Takahashi, Hajime Ito
pmc-13435053.description: Although silyllithium species are valuable reagents in organosilicon chemistry due to their versatile reactivity and utility, especially in Si–Si bond-forming reactions, access to functionalized variants remains limited. In particular, while dimethylphenylsilyllithium is widely used, functionalized arylsilyllithium species remain extremely rare because classical lithium-mediated reduction of chlorosilanes is largely restricted to simple substrates.

pmc-13490661.title: Public (un)willingness to trade-off benefits and harms in decisions about cancer screening: A discrete choice experiment
pmc-13490661.creator: Rebecca A Dennison, Stuart Wright, Georgios Lyratzopoulos, Nora Pashayan, Stephen Morris, Brian Nicholson, Thiscovery Authorship Group, Juliet A Usher-Smith
pmc-13490661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesTo quantify the harms participants are willing to accept for varying benefits from cancer screening following provision of information.MethodsWe conducted an online discrete choice experiment with two samples of the UK public. Attributes were number of cancer diagnoses and deaths prevented (benefits) and overdiagnoses, false positives and false negatives (harms) for a population who are/are not screened for an unspecified cancer over their lifetimes.
